judge_context: The fix belongs in requests.utils.prepend_scheme_if_needed: urllib3's parse_url already returns the auth component, so the idiomatic change re-joins it onto netloc ('@'.join([auth, netloc])) with a short comment before urlunparse. No new helpers, version checks or changes to proxy handling in adapters/sessions are needed.

case_items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
case_items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
case_items.question: Apart from re-attaching auth, does requests.utils.prepend_scheme_if_needed keep its signature and behaviour for URLs without credentials (scheme-less 'example.com/path', '//example.com/path', 'host:port'), and is the fix implemented in requests itself rather than by pinning/patching urllib3 or depending on the Python version?

criteria.perfect: Signature unchanged; only auth re-attached to netloc (from parse_url's auth field); no urllib3/python-version special-casing.
criteria.accept: Behaviour correct but implemented with an unnecessary Python-version check or re-parsing via a second URL parser.
criteria.bad: Signature or no-auth behaviour changed, the fix pins/patches urllib3, or credentials are percent-encoded/decoded differently from the input.
